about.headline: Bridging computational design and architectural craftsmanship.
about.introParagraph1: Starting with a deep passion for architectural forms, structural logic, and spatial narrative, my work focuses on contemporary spaces that dialogue with their physical and cultural environment.
about.introParagraph2: Specializing in tectonic research, digital fabrication, and contextual design, I explore innovative design methodologies and spatial experiences through iterative prototyping.
